map.创业或内部项目立项时起名：给定核心词（如「笔记/效率」），组合生成易记、易读的应: Naming at startup or internal project kick-off: given core words (such as "notes / efficiency"), generate memorable, easy-to-read app names as a candidate list before publishing to the App Store or an Android store.
map.为海外版本准备英文名：在中文候选基础上生成可读的英文/拼音组合，便于后续查域名与: Preparing English names for an overseas version: generate readable English/pinyin combinations from Chinese candidates to make later domain and trademark checks easier.
map.做 A/B 命名测试：一次产出多个风格（极简/叠词/功能型），供团队投票或用户调: Running A/B naming tests: produce several styles at once (minimal / reduplicative / functional) for team voting or user research.
map.关键词填「笔记、效率」，风格选「功能型」，生成「速记星、NoteFlow、闪记、: Enter the keywords "notes, efficiency" and choose the "functional" style to generate candidates such as "QuickNote, NoteFlow, SnapNote, EfficiencyBox"; among them NoteFlow reads well in English and the domain note-flow.com is likely unregistered, making it a good name for an overseas version.
map.生成的应用名能直接用吗？: Can I use the generated app names directly?
map.仅作灵感与候选，正式上线前务必查商标（中国商标网/USPTO）、应用商店重名与域: They are inspiration and candidates only. Before launch, check trademarks (China Trademark Office / USPTO), store name conflicts and domain availability to avoid infringement or rejection.
map.商店搜索与图标下方展示空间有限，2~4 个汉字或不超过 12 个字母最易记；过长: Store search and icon labels have limited space; 2–4 Chinese characters or up to 12 letters are easiest to remember. Longer names get truncated and are harder to spread by word of mouth.
map.按所选类别取词库，随机抽取 A 段；勾选紧凑后缀时直接拼接 B 段，否则未勾选无: Pick the word list for the selected category and randomly draw segment A; when the compact suffix option is on, append segment B directly, otherwise add a space when no-space is off, and keep only segment A in other cases; output count = count; each item independently random
map.创业或内部项目立项时起名：选择应用类别（社交/效率/金融/游戏/健康），组合生成: Naming a startup or internal project: choose an app category (social, productivity, finance, game, health) and generate memorable, readable app names as a candidate list before store submission.
map.为海外版本准备英文名：在英文候选基础上按需调整后缀与空格，便于后续查域名与商标。: Preparing an English name for an overseas release: adjust suffixes and spacing on the English candidates, then check domains and trademarks.
map.做 A/B 命名测试：一次产出多个候选，并用「加后缀」「无空格」开关比较不同形态: Running an A/B naming test: produce several candidates at once and compare forms with the "add suffix" and "no space" switches for team voting or user research.
map.类别选「效率」，勾选「加后缀」和「无空格」，可生成 SyncBox、Smarti: Choose the "Productivity" category and tick "add suffix" and "no space" to generate candidates such as SyncBox, Smartify, Timekit and Planly; adapt them by hand if you need a Chinese name.
